title: Probability & Expectation DP
relevance: Medium (simple probability / “expected count via indicators” shows up in harder OAs; full expectation-DP with self-loops is mainly a CF ~1600–2100 rating skill Striver never covers)
company_notes: Each of n kids rolls 1..k uniformly — expected maximum candy (Candy Lottery / Little Pony Expected Maximum). Array entries uniform in ranges — expected inversions / equal pairs via indicator sum (Inversion Probability style). Monster HP n, each hit deals 1 or 2 — expected hits mod prime (Critical Hit). Keep tossing/drawing until every type collected or every plate empty — coupon / Sushi expectation DP with self-loops.

phases.goal: Spot probability / expectation asks and when linearity of indicators replaces DP.

must_hit.point: Spot it when the statement asks for a probability or expected value under random draws, random walks, random survivors, or “until all done,” with a small state space (counts, masks, remaining HP, dish multiplicities).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Names that ask shape and cites a small state like counts, masks, HP, or dish multiplicities.

must_hit.point: For “expected count” problems, reach for linearity of indicators first — often no DP is needed (inversions, empty cells, node removed directly).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Says E[count] = sum of event probabilities and names an indicator-style example before proposing DP.

must_hit.point: OA disguises: expected maximum of uniform rolls; expected inversions/equal pairs; HP hits dealing 1 or 2 with given Prob; toss/draw until every type collected or every plate empty.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Maps at least one of those phrasings to expected-max, indicator sum, Critical Hit–style HP DP, or coupon/Sushi.

probes: What in the statement tells you this is probability/expectation rather than ordinary DP?
Would you try linearity of indicators before writing a DP state?

hints.1: Look for the words probability / expected value and a random process.
hints.2: If it asks for an expected count, try indicators first; otherwise check that the remaining state is small.
hints.3: Say: Prob/E under random draws/walks/survivors/until-all-done + small counts/masks/HP/dishes; expected counts → Σ P(eventᵢ) often without DP.

phases.goal: Choose forward probability DP, backward expectation DP, or linearity / geometric closed form.

must_hit.point: Probability DP pushes forward: dp[v] += dp[u] * P(u→v); answer is a sum of dp[terminal] (or Prob of a property).
must_hit.evidence_hint: States the forward multiply-by-edge-probability recurrence and where the answer is read.

must_hit.point: Expectation DP pulls backward: E[term]=0; E[s] = cost(s) + Σ P(s→t)·E[t]; if t=s is possible, rearrange the self-loop (“geometric wait”).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Gives the backward recurrence and mentions isolating E when a self-transition exists.

must_hit.point: Linearity: E[Σ Xᵢ] = Σ E[Xᵢ] with no independence needed — turns many expected-count problems into summing indicator probabilities.
must_hit.evidence_hint: States the linearity identity and that dependence does not block it.

must_hit.point: Geometric wait: success Prob p each trial ⇒ expected trials 1/p (Sushi empty-dish / coupon phases).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Quotes expected trials 1/p and ties it to coupon or empty-dish waits.

probes: Is your DP forward probability, backward expectation, or just linearity of indicators?
If the process can stay in the same state, how do you set up the expectation equation?

hints.1: Decide whether you need Prob of a state, E from a state, or only an expected count.
hints.2: Forward: multiply edge probs; backward: E from terminals; expected counts: indicators; self-loop: geometric wait.
hints.3: Say: dp[v]+=dp[u]*P(u→v); E[s]=cost+Σ P·E[t] (rearrange if t=s); E[Σ Xᵢ]=Σ E[Xᵢ]; success p ⇒ 1/p waits.

phases.goal: Write self-loop isolation, output format, and the common Prob/E state templates.

must_hit.point: When a self-loop is allowed: E[s] = (cost + Σ_{t≠s} P·E[t]) / (1−P_self) — rearrange E = 1 + p₀E + … to isolate E (Sushi milestone).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Writes the divided-by-(1−P_self) form or equivalently isolating E from the self term.

must_hit.point: Float vs modular: print doubles with setprecision and absolute/relative 1e-6…1e-9, or output P·Q⁻¹ mod 998244353 / 1e9+7.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Names either the double precision band or the modular inverse fraction form with a modulus from the topic.

must_hit.point: Common states: dp[i][j] = Prob exactly j heads after i coins; E[i][j][k] on dish multiplicities; dp[mask] = Prob subset still alive; E(x,y,z) until some color hits 100; dp[w][b] turn-based draws.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Names at least two of those concrete state shapes and what they mean.

must_hit.point: Bitmask probability: state = alive set / chosen subset; transition enumerates pairs or challengers inside the mask (n≤20).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Says mask = alive/chosen set and transitions fight/challenger pairs inside it under n≤20.

probes: Show the algebra that isolates E when the next state can be the same state.
What state would you use for heads-count, Sushi dishes, Fish alive-set, or bag-of-mice draws—and how is the answer printed?

hints.1: Write the one-step equation including the stay-put probability, then solve for E.
hints.2: Move the self term to the left; pick a state from coins/dishes/mask/colors; match float vs mod output.
hints.3: Say: E=(cost+Σ_{t≠s} P·E[t])/(1−P_self); states like dp[i][j], E[i][j][k], dp[mask], E(x,y,z) to 100; doubles at 1e-6…1e-9 or P·Q⁻¹ mod 998244353/1e9+7; mask fights for n≤20.

phases.goal: Justify that the chosen state space is small enough, and when closed form beats DP.

must_hit.point: These DPs are aimed at small state spaces: counts, masks, remaining HP, or dish multiplicities — not huge unconstrained graphs.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Explicitly ties feasibility to one of those small state encodings.

must_hit.point: Bitmask probability DP enumerates pairs/challengers inside the alive mask and is the pattern when n≤20.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Quotes n≤20 as the bitmask-probability constraint cue.

must_hit.point: Prefer linearity / indicators or closed-form geometric waits (e.g. coupon N/(N−k) phases) over building a full expectation DP when the count decomposes.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Says skip heavy DP when indicators or geometric/coupon closed form already give the answer.

probes: Why is your state small enough to DP?
When would you refuse to write an expectation DP and use indicators or a geometric wait instead?

hints.1: Ask what dimensions the state actually has.
hints.2: Counts/masks/HP/dishes stay small; masks need n≤20; indicators/geometry can replace DP.
hints.3: Say: state = counts/masks/HP/dish multiplicities; bitmask alive-set when n≤20; else try Σ P(eventᵢ) or 1/p / N/(N−k) waits before DP.

phases.goal: Catch self-loop algebra mistakes, false independence demands, output-format errors, and missing boundaries.

must_hit.point: Leaving E on both sides when t=s is possible (writing E = 1 + p₀E + … without isolating E) yields an unsolved equation.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Calls out the unsolved self-loop form and the need to divide by (1−P_self).

must_hit.point: Requiring independence before using E[count] = Σ P(eventᵢ) — linearity holds even when events are dependent.
must_hit.evidence_hint: States that dependence does not block indicator linearity.

must_hit.point: Wrong answer channel: printing a raw fraction under a prime mod, or using doubles when the judge wants P·Q⁻¹ mod 998244353 / 1e9+7 (or the reverse precision band).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Distinguishes modular inverse fraction output from setprecision doubles at 1e-6…1e-9.

must_hit.point: Vague state that omits whose turn / what remains, and skips boundary cases (0 of a type, empty bag, already sorted).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Insists on turn/remaining in the state and names at least one explicit base case.

probes: What goes wrong if the process can self-loop and you do not rearrange?
Do you need independence for linearity, and which base cases must be written first?

hints.1: Check the stay-put term, independence assumptions, output format, and empty/zero bases.
hints.2: Isolate E; linearity needs no independence; match float vs mod; define turn/remaining and 0/empty/sorted cases.
hints.3: List: rearrange self-loop; E[Σ Xᵢ]=Σ E[Xᵢ] even if dependent; doubles vs P·Q⁻¹ mod 998244353/1e9+7; state includes whose turn/what remains with 0-of-type / empty bag / already sorted bases.

tradeoffs.topic: Linearity of indicators vs full expectation DP
tradeoffs.strong_answer: For expected counts (inversions, empty cells, node removed directly), sum indicator probabilities with no independence needed and often skip DP; switch to expectation DP when the process is “until all done” with interacting remaining counts/dishes/HP and self-loops.

tradeoffs.topic: Forward probability DP vs backward expectation DP
tradeoffs.strong_answer: Push Prob forward with dp[v]+=dp[u]*P(u→v) when the answer is Prob of reaching terminals or a property; pull E backward from E[term]=0 with E[s]=cost+Σ P·E[t] when the answer is expected cost/steps from a start state.

tradeoffs.topic: Closed-form geometric / coupon waits vs self-loop expectation DP
tradeoffs.strong_answer: Use 1/p or coupon-style N/(N−k) waits when phases are independent geometric successes; use full E[i][j][k]-style DP (Sushi) when multiplicities interact and you must rearrange E=1+p₀E+… inside each state.

Print doubles with setprecision and absolute/relative 1e-6…1e-9 when the statement asks for a real; output P·Q⁻¹ mod 998244353 / 1e9+7 when the statement wants an exact fraction under a prime modulus (Critical Hit / Beautiful Mirrors style).

gotchas.trap: Writing E = 1 + p₀E + … and treating it as already solved when a self-loop exists.
gotchas.correction: Move the self term: E[s] = (cost + Σ_{t≠s} P·E[t]) / (1−P_self).

gotchas.trap: Refusing linearity because the indicator events are dependent.
gotchas.correction: E[Σ Xᵢ] = Σ E[Xᵢ] needs no independence — sum P(eventᵢ) for inversions, empty cells, etc.

gotchas.trap: Using integer division (or raw floats) when the judge wants a modular fraction.
gotchas.correction: Output P·Q⁻¹ mod 998244353 / 1e9+7; for real answers use setprecision with absolute/relative 1e-6…1e-9.

gotchas.trap: State that does not define whose turn / what remains, with missing 0-of-type / empty-bag / already-sorted bases.
gotchas.correction: Put turn and remaining counts (or mask) into the state and draw those boundary cases explicitly before transitions.
